newsitem.title: USA: Top U.S. general to visit NATO headquarters. [CORRECTED 17:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Top U.S. general to visit NATO headquarters. [CORRECTED 17:40 GMT]

text.p: U.S. Army Gen. John Shalikashvili, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, will discuss NATO issues with Atlantic alliance counterparts in Belgium on Tuesday (corrects from Wednesday), the Pentagon said.

Shalikashvili was flying to Brussels later on Tuesday to attend a regular meeting of the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation's Military Committee and chiefs of staff, including talks on Bosnia peacekeeping and planned changes in NATO military structure.
He will return to Washington on Wednesday, the Pentagon said.
